children: Cumberland Pharmaceuticals said long-term safety and efficacy data from its ongoing open-label extension of the Phase 2 FIGHT DMD trial will not be available in August 2026 as previously indicated.
Presented Phase 2 FIGHT DMD data at Parent Project Muscular Dystrophy conference; slide had indicated August 2026 for long-term data.
Company now says the long-term open-label extension data is not yet available and will not be presented in August 2026.
Cumberland intends to present the long-term data at a future date once it becomes available.

title: Cumberland Pharmaceuticals delays August 2026 FIGHT DMD long-term data presentation
